qualification_comparison.interpretation: R3 reached a spool 81.7 percent larger than the qualified synthetic spool even though the frozen real base-candidate population is 1.06 percent smaller; source-row cardinality alone cannot explain the failure.

read_only_source_shape_diagnostic.method: Stream-parse the already-authorised C2 source artifact; exclude C2_PARENT_OBSERVATION from base-candidate counts; count exact geometry signatures, owner classes and relation-topology variants by side/kind. No evaluate_pair, tracklet, assertion, match-decision or ObjectPack semantic runtime was invoked.

root_cause.finding: The full-cardinality qualification matched population size but collapsed the semantic state to two assertions/two tracklets and approximately one evidence vector per candidate. The real source has hundreds of thousands of distinct geometries concentrated into four hard scopes. The runtime compares each incoming candidate against eligible assertions/open tracklets in its hard scope and persists a JSON evidence vector for each comparison, so storage is state-density and competitor-density sensitive, not row-cardinality-only.
secondary_contributors: Real normalized geometry and identity strings are materially wider than the compact synthetic fixture values, increasing JSON payload width.

SQLite table, index and page growth scales with the number and width of candidates, evidence vectors, decisions, assertions and tracklets; qualification did not establish a high-density upper bound for those tables.
not_primary: MEMORY: R3 peak RSS was 27013120 bytes versus a 1160593408-byte limit.
SOURCE_ORDER_ADAPTER_PERSISTENCE: the v0.2 source-order adapter performs logical-stream ordering/merge and does not create a second persistent full-population database.
SOURCE_ROW_CARDINALITY: the frozen base-candidate population is smaller than the synthetic full-cardinality population.

evidence_gap.reason: The fail-closed R3 path deleted the partial SQLite spool after recording only its total byte size. The failure receipt did not preserve processed-row count, per-table row counts, page_count/page_size/freelist_count or dbstat allocation.
evidence_gap.consequence: The diagnosis proves that the qualification envelope was not representative, but cannot retrospectively apportion the 6.535 GB exactly between evidence-vector multiplicity, payload width and SQLite index/page overhead.
required_recovery_telemetry: per-table-and-index allocation via dbstat when available
runtime_spool_database_bytes and peak_rss_bytes at each checkpoint

permitted_if_operator_approves_recovery: Add non-scientific storage telemetry that does not alter candidate, predicate, threshold, identity, selection or activation semantics.

Construct adversarial synthetic/non-evidentiary capacity fixtures that bound real-source hard-scope concentration, geometry repetition diversity, payload width and competitor density without executing the real source semantically.
Develop a semantics-preserving internal materialisation compaction only if required, with exact output/reference equivalence and deterministic hash proofs.
Re-run targeted tests, full repository regression and full-cardinality/high-density synthetic capacity qualification.
Produce a separately measured proposed execution envelope and a fresh GRUN-R4 gate packet only after qualification passes.
forbidden: Creation or consumption of fresh real-source run authority
Population, source, candidate-generation, semantic, predicate, threshold or ObjectPack changes
Publication, probability, risk, exposure, trading, execution or agent-write authority
